source_spans.original_identifier: Reader I. The Creation of the World. First day.
source_spans.text: On anginne gescēop God heofonan and eorðan. Sēo eorðe sōðlice wæs īdel and ǣmtig; and ðīestru wǣron ofer ðǣre nēowolnesse brādnesse; and Godes gāst wæs gefęred ofer wæteru. God cwæð ðā, “Geweorðe lēoht”; and lēoht wearð geworht. God geseah ðā ðæt hit gōd wæs; and hē gedǣlde ðæt lēoht fram ðǣm ðīestrum. And hēt ðæt lēoht Dæg, and ðā ðīestru Niht. Ðā wæs geworden ǣfen and morgen ān dæg.

source_spans.original_identifier: Reader I. The Creation of the World. Second day.
source_spans.text: God cwæð ðā ęft, “Geweorðe nū fæstnes tōmiddes ðǣm wæterum, and tōtwǣme ðā wæteru fram ðǣm wæterum.” And God geworhte ðā fæstnesse, and tōtwǣmde ðā wæteru ðe wǣron under ðǣre fæstnesse fram ðǣm ðe wǣron bufan ðǣre fæstnesse; hit wæs ðā swā gedōn. And God hēt ðā fæstnesse Heofonan. And wæs ðā geworden ǣfen and morgen ōðer dæg.
